title: ChessFest!
transcript: Why is Gotham Chess on this massive screen? Well, you see, this is Chess Fest in London, an event that celebrates that majestic game that we all love. There are blindfold chess demonstrations by chess grandmasters, chess boards everywhere, and I got to meet some of you guys with the Fools Will Resign merch. And I also got a chance to play against a grandmaster. Overall, this was an amazing, fun, and chess-filled day, and I hope to be back next year.
